title: 第3章 还得叶秋玲自己出马第4章 榜一大哥
slug: 乡村大炮第296章先宣传一波
content_zh:
砰！
片刻之后，李长贵一头磕在桌子上，然后醉酒不醒。
反倒是李大炮，虽然有些上头，但依然没有醉。
“这个长贵，平常吹的自己酒量有多厉害，关键的时候就会掉链子。”
叶秋玲一阵无语，她狠狠踢了李长贵一脚，结果依然没有任何反应。
“大炮，你别喝酒了，吃馒头，这是我做的馒头。”
叶秋玲说道，她担心李大炮喝多了酒，到时就什么都做不了了。
“秋玲，你的馒头真大，真白，看着就想吃。”
李大炮口无遮拦，他抓起一个大白馒头，狠狠咬了一大口。
叶秋玲忽然浑身一颤，连忙伸手捂着胸口，这一刹那似乎又产生了什么错觉。
“大炮，我想找你帮我一个忙。”
叶秋玲红着脸说道，既然李长贵喝醉了，那么就只能她自己上了。
“要耕田还是种地，或者通下水道，尽管说，我绝对不白吃你的馒头。”
李大炮立即说道，嘴巴里还吃着馒头，说话有些含糊不清。
叶秋玲咬了咬嘴唇，要不是李大炮是真的傻子，肯定要怀疑他，是不是在故意调戏她。
李大炮只能说冤枉，因为平常那些村妇，找他就是干这些活。
“大炮，我，我，我生病了，需要，需要……”
“什么？你生病了，生病了该打针啊。”
“你，你，你会打针吗？”
叶秋玲紧张的拽着自己的裤子，修长笔直的美腿瞬间显出轮廓。

“我？我不会啊。”
李大炮憨憨地说道，他又不是给人打针的医生，哪里会治病。
“你不会，我可以教你。”
叶秋玲温柔的说道，她拉起李大炮的一只手，含情脉脉的看着他。
李大炮懵里懵懂的眨眨眼睛，只觉得叶秋玲在影响他啃馒头。
“跟我回房间，我慢慢教你。”
叶秋玲说道，她不想再让人说闲话，说她是个不下蛋的母鸡，必须得证明给她们看，她会下蛋。
李大炮被她拉了起来，临走前他又拿了一个馒头，偷偷藏在了口袋里，准备带回家当夜宵。
只是他现在，就是叶秋玲的夜宵。
轰！
片刻之后，伴随着叶秋玲的一声惨叫，李大炮忽然感觉自己的脑海炸开了一样，接着他胸前的一个玉葫芦，化为一道绿色的光芒，钻进了他的体内。
“我乃李氏先祖，因为争夺先天灵宝功德葫芦而殒命，今你得我传承，赐你混沌阴阳仙经一部，此仙经需要女人纯阴之血开启修炼，望你早日证得道果！”
一道声音在李大炮的脑海中响起，随后一股力量自玉葫芦里面喷薄而出，混沌阴阳仙经自主在他的体内运转起来。
首先他脑海里的淤血瞬间被炼化，他整个人一瞬间恢复了清醒，结束了浑浑噩噩的日子。
接着丹田一暖，直接开辟，然后凝聚出了一缕混沌之气。
“呜呜呜！”
不知道过了多久，一道哭泣的声音惊醒了李大炮，他这才发现，自己身上趴着一个人，这个人正是叶秋玲。
“秋玲，你在干什么？”
李大炮有些懵逼，刚刚得到传承，脑袋恢复了正常，一时忘记了之前的事情。
不过在干什么还是知道的，他心中一连三个卧槽，没想到这种好事竟然发生在了他的身上。

“我在，我在，不是说了我生病了吗？你在给我治病。”
叶秋玲连忙忽悠，她把李大炮当傻子，当小孩一样忽悠。
李大炮想起了之前的事情，只是他不知道叶秋玲为什么这么做？
村里那些村妇平常虽然看他傻，也会调戏一下他，但并没有玩真的。
但是今天，叶秋玲会不会太疯狂了，竟然玩真的。
content_en:
Bang!
After a while, Li Changgui knocked his head on the table and became drunk.
On the contrary, Li Dapao, although a little drunk, was still not drunk.
"This is Changgui. He usually brags about how good he is at drinking, but he will lose his temper at critical moments."
Ye Qiuling was speechless for a while. She kicked Li Changgui hard, but there was still no reaction.
"Dapao, stop drinking and eat steamed buns. These are steamed buns made by me."
Ye Qiuling said that she was worried that Li Dapao would be unable to do anything if he drank too much.
"Qiuling, your steamed buns are so big and white, I want to eat them just looking at them."
Li Dapao's mouth was unobstructed. He grabbed a big white steamed bun and took a big bite.
Ye Qiuling suddenly trembled, and quickly reached out to cover her chest. At this moment, she seemed to have another illusion.
"Cannon, I want to ask you to do me a favor."
Ye Qiuling blushed and said, since Li Changgui was drunk, she had to do it by herself.
"If you want to plow the land or connect the sewers, just say it, I will never eat your steamed buns in vain."
Li Dapao said immediately, still eating steamed buns in his mouth, and his words were a little unclear.
Ye Qiuling bit her lip. If Li Dapao hadn't been a real fool, she would have doubted whether he was deliberately teasing her.
Li Dapao could only say that he was wronged, because those village women usually came to him to do this kind of work.
"Cannon, I, I, I'm sick, need, need..."
"What? You are sick. If you are sick, you should get an injection."
"You, you, can you give injections?"
Ye Qiuling nervously tugged on her pants, her long and straight legs instantly showing their outline.
"Me? I can't."
Li Dapao said naively, he is not a doctor who gives injections, so how can he treat people?
"If you don't know how, I can teach you."
Ye Qiuling said softly, she took one of Li Dapao's hands and looked at him lovingly.
Li Dapao blinked in confusion, feeling that Ye Qiuling was influencing him to eat the steamed buns.
"Come back to your room with me, and I'll teach you slowly."
Ye Qiuling said that she didn't want people to gossip and say that she was a hen that couldn't lay eggs. She had to prove to them that she could lay eggs.
Li Dapao was pulled up by her. Before leaving, he took another steamed bun and secretly hid it in his pocket, preparing to take it home as a midnight snack.
But now, he is Ye Qiuling's midnight snack.
boom!
A moment later, with Ye Qiuling's scream, Li Dapao suddenly felt as if his mind was exploding, and then a jade gourd on his chest turned into a green light and penetrated into his body.
"I am the ancestor of the Li family. I died because of the fight for the gourd of innate spiritual treasures. Now you have my inheritance. I will give you a Chaos Yin and Yang Immortal Sutra. This Immortal Sutra requires the pure yin blood of a woman to start cultivation. I hope you can achieve Taoism and Fruition as soon as possible!"
A voice sounded in Li Dapao's mind, and then a burst of power spurted out from the jade gourd, and the Chaos Yin and Yang Immortal Sutra began to operate autonomously in his body.
First of all, the blood congestion in his mind was instantly refined, and he regained consciousness in an instant, ending his hazy days.
Then the Dantian warmed up, opened up directly, and then condensed a wisp of chaotic energy.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
I don't know how long it took, but a crying sound woke up Li Dapao. Only then did he realize that there was a person lying on top of him, and this person was Ye Qiuling.
"Qiuling, what are you doing?"
Li Dapao was a little confused. He had just received the inheritance, his mind returned to normal, and he temporarily forgot what happened before.
But he still knew what he was doing, and he thought, "F*ck" in his mind. He didn't expect that such a good thing would happen to him.
"I'm here, I'm here, didn't I tell you I was sick? You are treating me."
Ye Qiuling quickly deceived Li Dapao as if he were a fool and a child.
Li Dapao remembered what happened before, but he didn't know that Ye QiulingWhy do this?
Although the village women in the village usually thought he was stupid and would tease him, they didn't take it seriously.
But today, Ye Qiuling was too crazy to play it real.
